prior_blocker_resolution.first_backup_failure: backup-preparation exception is handled before the publish transaction; originals are never passed to _rollback_one and remain untouched
prior_blocker_resolution.second_backup_failure: the completed first backup is best-effort removed by _abort_backup_prep while both originals remain untouched
prior_blocker_resolution.publish_barrier: publish begins only after every existed-before target has a returned backup path that still exists

accepted_properties: ranges form the exact contiguous partition of expected_total with an exact remainder chunk
canonical chunk names, missing and extra pattern files, exact sizes, directories and scan-visible symlinks are fail-closed
output and manifest symlinks, directory targets, same resolved path and expected source-chunk conflicts are rejected
every chunk is stream-hashed during scan and independently rehashed during assembly
the published output is independently re-read for exact size and SHA256 before manifest publication
overwrite is refused by default and force mode uses prepared backups plus independent two-target rollback
manifest replace followed by directory-fsync failure enters rollback and partial rollback failure preserves recoverable backups
manifest bytes are deterministic for the same verified inputs and output basename
the module has no network, subprocess, gzip or tar parsing semantics

test_evidence.environment_limitation: all 35 errors occurred in pytest tmp_path setup because the Windows sandbox denied access to C:\Users\user\AppData\Local\Temp\pytest-of-user; no candidate assertion failure was observed
test_evidence.main_agent_secondary_evidence: previously reported 38 target passed / 217 full passed; those counts predate the two added T1 regression tests and are not treated as proof of the current test bytes
test_evidence.required_before_any_real_assembly: run the complete current-SHA target and repository suites in a normal writable temporary-directory environment

residual_risks: output and manifest use per-file atomic replace rather than cross-file atomic commit; consumers must verify the manifest/output hash pair
directory fsync is best-effort on hosts that cannot open directory handles
local concurrent path or symlink replacement remains a TOCTOU risk; execution directories must be single-writer and trusted
output and manifest should remain outside the chunk namespace and must not use chunk-pattern names
the prepublish backup-ready assertion is disabled by python -O; real use must not use optimized mode and may later replace the assertion with an explicit fail-closed exception
claim_boundary: GO_COMMIT_TRANSPORT_ASSEMBLER authorizes Git preservation of the exact reviewed transport tool, synthetic tests, and review evidence only. It authorizes no real chunk access or assembly, no gzip/tar semantics, no real overwrite, no formal preflight, no training, and no GO_RUN.
